title: China’s Mega Banks Post Record Profits as Margins Recover
dc:creator: Bloomberg News
content: China’s top state banks reported their strongest quarterly profits ever, as improved margins and trading gains from bond investments outweighed sluggish loan growth in a slowing economy.

title: Tesco Strikes €1.7 Billion Deal to Sell Czech, Slovakia Unit
dc:creator: Maddie Parker, Charlotte Hughes-Morgan and Daniel Hornak
content: Tesco Plc agreed to sell its supermarket arm in Czech Republic and Slovakia to Ahold Delhaize for an enterprise value of €1.7 billion (£1.5 billion), effectively marking the end of its previous plan to become a global grocery giant.

title: Tech Stock Selloff Deepens on Earnings, Oil Rises: Markets Wrap
dc:creator: Robert Brand and Rivaldo Jantjies
content: US stock futures fell for a second day after another round of disappointing tech earnings accelerated a rotation out of the sector amid signs that the core businesses of America’s tech giants are slowing as they pour money into artificial intelligence. Crude oil gained.

title: Whistleblowers Claimed Key Oil Tanker Rate Was Manipulated

title: BlackRock Says Bonds Offer Compelling Income Opportunity
content: James Turner, BlackRock’s head of global fixed income for EMEA, says bonds offer an "extremely strong" income opportunity with yields at generational highs. "It's just such an attractive time to invest in fixed income," he tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: GLP-1 Demand Boosts Dis-Chem’s South Africa Pharmacy Revenue

title: Credit Agricole Reports Higher Profit, Warns of France Risk
content: Clotilde L'Angevin, deputy general manager at Credit Agricole, speaks on Bloomberg Television after the lender joined its French rivals in reporting higher profit for the third quarter, but warned that the recent turmoil in France could hurt business there in coming months. "Going forward, we want to remain very cautious because it is possible that the macroeconomic environment will have an impact on loan demand," L'Angevin says. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: BP Profit Hits 18-Year High as Oil Refining Margins Surge
